{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative (sentiment < 0) or shows early negative drift.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent high prices (last 5-7 days) when sentiment is positive, to avoid underestimating upward momentum.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is significantly below true outcome for 3+ consecutive days, gradually increase forecast by 1-2% per day.",
    "Reduce forecast overshoot after sharp spikes: if true outcome drops sharply after a peak, cap forecast decline at 5% below peak for 2-3 days.",
    "When sentiment is neutral or positive, prioritize aligning forecast with recent 30-day moving average to reduce lag error.",
    "For long-term (10+ day) forecasts, add a 1-3% upward bias to counteract downward drift in low-price regimes.",
    "If true outcome consistently exceeds forecast by >5% over 5+ days, increase forecast by 0.5-1% per day until convergence."
  ]
}
